test_conditions: Synthetic constant-potential current transients at −0.05 V vs an invented Li reference. No measured nucleation, passivation, deposited charge or stability.

reference.observation: Potentiostatic current-time transients can be displayed without fitting a nucleation model.
reference.review_scope: Paper text/figure checked; display idea only, no numerical values or artwork copied

scientific_basis.parameter_origin: Explicit original teaching parameters, not measured values
scientific_basis.validation_scope: Declared teaching model; no experimental/material certification
equations: An ideal voltage-step RC branch gives j0=abs(deltaV)/Rs and tau=Rs*C; a parallel resistor gives jsteady=abs(deltaV)/Rf
assumptions: Stationary passive voltage-step RC plus a constant resistive branch.
All passed charge is external; no deposited mass or nucleation mechanism is assigned.

references.title: Basics of Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy
references.supports: Passive resistor/capacitor current-voltage laws; not a nucleation model or paper fit.

limitations: Not Cottrell diffusion or Scharifker-Hills nucleation; cannot infer deposited Li, passivation or stability.
